```{exercise}
Define a probability space that could be used to model the outcome of throwing two fair 6-sided dice.

```

::: fold
```{solution, echo = togs}


- $\Omega = \{\{i,j\}, i = 1,...,6, j = 1,...,6\}$
  
- $F = 2^{\Omega}$
  
- $\forall \omega \in \Omega$, $P(\omega) = \frac{1}{6} \times \frac{1}{6} = \frac{1}{36}$

```
:::
